review: Qt native layouts reuse the original filters and exact widgets; search and image toggle share a row and source-specific related readers share a compact horizontal tool row. Existing MechanismTextBrowser supplies bold headings and anchors. The topic selector indexes only actual generated document headings, blocks rebuild signals, preserves same-source reading and resets on enemy/source changes. Clearing a failed reference also clears topics. Stack and text size policies let the browser shrink within the actual viewport, removing unintended second outer scrolling. Target entry now opens at800x480. Original enemy model, numeric forecasts, source verification and related reader routing remain unchanged. Total warnings move to tooltips while short scope labels remain visible. No new catch, retries, network/game/chat calls or dependencies.
